title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description_text:
Senior Test Automation Engineer 

Location: Chennai

Years of Exp: (7.1-9 years)

About Us

“Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery. 

WHY JOIN CAPCO?

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Responsibilities

  • Part of an international Agile squad with teams in Chennai & Belgium
  • Responsible for development, testing & maintenance of payment applications
  • Work closely with BNP Paribas Fortis Tribe Payments team
  • Participate in analysis, design, testing & support activities
  • Focus on test automation and high-quality software delivery
  • Design test cases and prepare test datasets
  • Build and maintain automation frameworks
  • Develop automated test scripts using Java-based frameworks
  • Execute automated test suites and prepare reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement & automation initiatives
  • Analyze requirements for automation feasibility

Technical Skills

  • Java 8 & 17, OOP concepts
  • REST API, XML & JSON testing
  • JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, BDD, Karate
  • Maven, Docker, GitLab, Jenkins
  • Swagger, JMeter, SQL, Oracle
  • SonarQube, Fortify, NexusIQ
  • IntelliJ, Insomnia, Bruno, Rally, Octane

Additional Skills

  • Strong understanding of STLC & testing methodologies
  • Experience in Agile & Scrum environment
  • Banking & Payments domain knowledge
  • Strong communication and fluent English
  • Bachelor’s Degree in IT or equivalent
  • 8+ years of experience in QA Automation & Java

Location

  • Chennai
